{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Finance Executive",
  "description": "Janchine Nigeria Limited is an outsourcing company into the recruitment and management of core and support staff.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Finance Executive

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos&nbsp;
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The Finance Executive is responsible for leading and managing the company&#39;s finance functions, ensuring the integrity of financial records, effective treasury and cash management, accurate financial reporting, statutory compliance, budgeting, payroll administration, tax management and the implimentation of sound financial controls.
	The role supports strategic decision making by providing timely and accurate financial information while safeguarding the company&#39;s financial assets and snsuring compliance with applicable laws, regulationns and internak policies.


Key Responsibilities


	Prepare the company&#39;s annual budget and support periodic budget reviews and forecasts
	Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual management accounts, financial reports and board reports
	Prepare monthly accurals, prepayment, journals and other accounting adjustment
	Manage the company&#39;s treasury function by overseeing cash flow, liquidity and working capital requirement
	Manage banking relationship and oversae all banking transaction
	Prepare periodic cash flow forecasts to ensure adequate funding for operational requirement
	Invest surplus funds in approved fixed deposit and money market instruments in accordance with company&#39;s investment policy, ensuring optimal returns, capital preservation and adequate liquidity
	Maintain effective account payable and recievable system
	Review invoices and payment requests to ensure appropriate approvals, budget availability, validity of claims and adequacy of suporting document
	Prepare, reconcile and maintain statutory tax accounts including VAT, Withholding Tax (WHT) PAYE and other applicable taxes
	Ensure compliance with tax laws, pension regulation and other statutory requiement
	Identify financial risk and recommend appropriate mitigation measures
	Safeguard the company&#39;s financial assets and ensure proper custody of financial records


Required Qualifications


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or related discipline
	5 - 10 years of progressive experience in accounting, finance, treasury, budgeting, taxation and financial reporting
	Professional accounting qualification (ICAN, ACCA, or CPA) is mandatory
	Demonstatred experience managing the finance function of an organization
	Sound knowlegde of International Fianacial Reporting Standard (IFRS), Nigerian tax laws and relevant financial regulations
	Proficiency in accounting software and advanced microsoft excel.


Key Competencies:


	Financial Management
	Financial Reporting
	Treasury and Cash Management
	Budgeting and Forecasting
	Tax Planning and Compliance
	Accounts Payable and Receivable Management
	Payroll Administration
	Internal Controls and Risk Management, Audit Cordination
	Fianncial Analysis
	Advance Microsoft Excel
	Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills
	Planning and Organising
	Attention to detail
	Integrity, Comfidentiality and Professional Ethics

	The Finance Executive is responsible for leading and managing the company's finance functions, ensuring the integrity of financial records, effective treasury and cash management, accurate financial reporting, statutory compliance, budgeting, payroll administration, tax management and the implimentation of sound financial controls.

	The role will provide strategic leadership across engineering, enterprise architecture, DevSecOps, API ecosystems and technology delivery.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute the Group’s engineering strategy in alignment with business and digital transformation objectives.
	Lead multidisciplinary engineering teams across backend, frontend, mobile and quality assurance.
	Own the end-to-end delivery of enterprise applications, digital platforms and strategic products, including TrustFort.
	Establish engineering standards, coding practices, Agile delivery frameworks and technical governance.
	Design and oversee scalable microservices, API-first and enterprise application architectures.
	Drive DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, secure software development and release governance.
	Ensure seamless integration across CRM, payment gateways, AI services, partner platforms and other enterprise systems.
	Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, including AI and automation, to enhance business capabilities.
	Partner with subsidiary Managing Directors and business leaders to translate business strategy into technology roadmaps.
	Oversee application modernization, solution architecture, vendor engineering and technology delivery across the Group.
	Build a high-performance engineering culture through coaching, mentoring and capability development.


Qualifications & Experience


	Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field; Master’s degree is an advantage.
	8–10 years’ experience in software engineering, with at least 4 years in engineering leadership.
	Proven experience delivering enterprise platforms within the financial services or insurance sector.
	Strong expertise in Java/Spring Boot, microservices, API architecture, DevSecOps and Agile delivery.
	Experience with AI solution integration, enterprise architecture and technology transformation.


Key Competencies:


	Engineering & Technology Leadership
	Enterprise Architecture
	Software & Product Delivery
	DevSecOps & Quality Engineering
	API & Systems Integration
	Strategic Execution
	Innovation & Emerging Technologies
	Stakeholder & Vendor Management.
